A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FPQ is an important component of contraceptive use, and that FPQ should be considered in the context of the overall FP service delivery environment.
family planning programs should prioritize the development of quality standards that reflect the needs and preferences of clients and that are aligned with the needs and capacities of facilities.

family planning programs and facilities can improve the quality of services they offer to women and girls, and in doing so, increase the likelihood that women will continue to use modern contraceptives.
the MLE Project's SDP assessment is a comprehensive, valid and reliable tool that can be applied to measure facility-level quality in FP services.
